//: Composite indexes. Firestore builds single-field indexes automatically, so
only queries that combine fields need an entry here.
This file is deliberately empty. Every query in the app is either:
1. a plain collection read (rules allow it for any signed-in user, so
2. a single equality filter — where('boothId','==',x) — which the
automatic single-field index serves on its own.
Multi-criteria filtering (status + assignee + text search + ...) happens
in-memory via lib/filters.ts rather than in the query. That is a
prototype-scale trade: it keeps this file empty and the deploy free of
composite-index management. The moment a query needs where(...) on one
field combined with orderBy on another, Firestore will reject it and the
error carries a console URL that creates exactly the right index — paste
the result here and commit it.
